checkpoints.title: Accessible local filter state
checkpoints.contract: A local Leptos component owns one String filter and presents a labeled keyboard-accessible input and live text. It performs no network I/O and needs no backend. The complete HTML loader and locked WASM build are included; browser interaction remains a separate verification gate.

checkpoints.title: Operations console with bounded network requests
checkpoints.contract: The complete reference Leptos client connects to the loopback simulated workbench. It models loading, error and empty states, filters, polling, watchlists, order reconciliation, history charts and jobs. Client state lost on reload is documented. Public fixture credentials are not a production identity system.
